workItem: N2-PREVIEW-SER: Whole-project playback, cross-shot transport, and lifecycle cleanup

validation.knownUnrelatedVerifierDebt: verify-day05 reaches an old recent-projects:list mismatch before the preview assertions; not used as Issue #567 evidence

observed: Default Project range starts playing from Shot 1 and reports a credible 2-shot / 5-second total.
Automatic Shot 1 to Shot 2 transition selects Shot 2 at its local time; subtitle, image, mouth projection, and dialogue-bound audio path follow Shot 2.
Exact boundary 2500ms maps to Shot 2 local time 0; terminal time maps to Shot 2 local duration and stops.
A-to-B and B-to-A seeks pause at the destination; Play resumes from the destination without a second player.
Stop resets to Shot 1 time 0 and stays stopped; Replay resets to 0 and plays.
Whole Project and Current Shot ranges reset locally; close/reopen creates a fresh preview session and leaves editor revision, history, and selection unchanged.
The overlay uses the existing cinema surface with a centered Stage, compact range control, Chinese subtitle content, and no nested debug metadata.
limitations: This is agent-observed Windows Electron runtime evidence using CDP and viewed screenshots.
Maintainer listening, physical mouse/touch/cloud-input feel, and final human acceptance remain unmeasured.

required: Real Windows Electron start-to-finish two-shot playback with audible A/B audio check
A-to-B and B-to-A seek, Stop, Play, Replay, range switching, close/reopen
Representative Chinese/long content, constrained window and declared input checks
Confirmation that editor selection, project data, revision, and history remain unchanged
